meta.title: dbms.pi
meta.description: Goob shaqo oo DBA iyo SQLP ah oo lagu socodsiiyo matoorada DB si degdeg ah oo ammaan ah

home.headline: Ka dhig matoorkaaga DB inuu xogtaada u socodsiiyo si degdeg ah oo ammaan ah
home.description: Waa goob shaqo oo DBA iyo SQLP ah oo loogu talagalay qorshayaasha fulinta, tirakoobyada, iyo waxqabadka. schema.pi waxay gacanta ku haysaa naqshadaynta iyo heerarka; dbms.pi waa lammaanaheeda dhinaca matoorka.

featDesc.connect: Diiwaangeli calaamadda isku xirka schema.pi oo hubi heerka isku xirka
featDesc.sqlLab: Geedka qorshaha, digniinaha, isbarbardhigga iyo hubinta qaababka ka hortagga ee ka dhanka ah domainyada heerka
featDesc.perf: Weydiinta gaabiska ah Top-N, caafimaadka miiska/index, saadaasha awoodda, dhaqdhaqaaqa iyo qufulada
featDesc.monitor: Soo koobidda cabbirka App, DB iyo URL oo leh digniino xaddidan
featDesc.drift: Isbarbardhig schema.pi model iyo taariikhda DDL oo leh buugga dhabta ah, cabbir saamaynta index
featDesc.migration: Amarka rarista topological, qaybaha, liiska hubinta iyo SQL xaqiijinta
featDesc.pipeline: Hubinta hore ee qabashada isbeddelka iyo qeexitaannada dhuumaha isha→beddel→bartilmaameedka
featDesc.analytics: Dashboard KPI, khariidadda harada 3-lakab iyo buugga xogta
featDesc.ops: Baadhitaan akhris-kaliya ah oo ku saabsan cabbirrada, doorarka, kaydinta iyo soo celinta DR
featDesc.learn: Su'aalaha tababarka SQLP/DAP, kiisaska hagaajinta iyo qaamuuska isbarbardhigga DBMS

drift.title: Model ↔ DB Isbeddel

learn.title: Barashada DBA
learn.intro: Su'aalaha tababarka SQLP/DAP, buugga kiisaska hagaajinta, iyo qaamuuska isbarbardhigga Oracle/Tibero/PostgreSQL. Waxay shaqeysaa iyada oo aan lahayn isku xir; dooro isku xir si aad sidoo kale u aragto khariidadda nooca heerka schema.pi.

quiz.scoreLine: {solved} oo ka mid ah {total} ayaa la xalliyay · {correct} sax ah

cases.notice: Dhammaan kiisaska waa tusaalooyin waxbarasho oo iskeed loo qoray; tirooyinku waa tusaale (ma jiraan xog macmiil).

dict.liveTitle: Khariidadda nooca heerka ee aagga mawduucayga
dict.liveIntro: Dooro isku xir si aad u soo shubto profile-ka DBMS ee schema.pi (nooca macquulka ah → nooca jirka). Qaamuuska kor ku xusan wuxuu shaqeeyaa iyada oo aan lahayn isku xir.

link2.intro: Diiwaangeli calaamad isku xirka si aad u isticmaasho isku xirka DB ee aagga mawduuca schema.pi ee dbms.pi. Calaamadaha waxaa lagu kaydiyaa si qarsoodi ah, mana jiraan xog saf ah oo ka timid xogtaada oo la kaydiyo.

migration.title: Socdaalka Xogta (PiMig)
migration.intro: Waxay xisaabisaa amarka rarista miiska ee ka yimid xiriirka ku jira schema.pi model naqshadayntaada, waxay abaabushaa cabbirka qaybta, isbarbardhigga iyo liiska hubinta goynta, waxayna abuurtaa SQL xaqiijinta oo aad adigu ku socodsiiso isha iyo bartilmaameedka. Shaashaddan waxay qorsheysaa oo kaliya hubisaa — ma dhaqaajiso xogta ama ma akhrido safafka DB ee macmiilka.
migration.needLink: Marka hore dooro isku xirka schema.pi ee kor ku xusan. Haddii aadan midna haysan, diiwaangeli calaamad ku jirta menu-ka 'Isku xirka'.
migration.snapHint: Naqshadaynta wakhtigan (magacyada miiska, tiirarka iyo xiriirka) waxaa loo qaboojiyaa sidii sawir. Abuur qorshe cusub marka model-ka isbeddelo.
migration.dropped: ({n} xiriirro aan lahayn miisas jireed ayaa laga saaray kala-soocidda)
migration.optsHint: Isbarbardhiggu waa tirada miisaska la soo shubay isku mar gudaha heer. Cabbirka qaybta waa cutubka commit (safaf) ee matoorka fulintu isticmaali doono.
migration.orderHint: Si topoloji ahaan ayaa loo kala soocay xiriirrada naqshadeynta (ma aha FKs jireed) si miisaska waalidku u horreeyaan. Miisaska isku heerka ah isku tiirsanaan ma leh waxaana lagu rari karaa si isku mid ah.
migration.cycles: {n} koox(o) wareeg ah — oo la dhigay isku heer. Gacanta ku hagaaji amarkooda oo dib u dhig hubinta tixraaca ilaa inta la rarayo ka dib.
migration.selfRefs: Miisaska isku tixraacaya (heerarka) — marka hore rar safafka waalidka gudaha miiska
migration.readyNeedAll: Hubi shay kasta ka hor intaadan u calaamadin qorshaha diyaar.

cdcHandoff.title: Barta wareejinta CDC
cdcHandoff.desc: Diiwaangeli barta isha joogtada ah ka hor inta aan la rarin (PG LSN · Oracle/Tibero SCN · si loo codeeyo, wakhtiga bilowga oo laga jaray daaqad isku-dhafan), ka bilow CDC halkaas, oo nuug nuqullada daaqadda wareejinta oo leh upserts.

valueConv.title: Beddelidda qiimaha
valueConv.desc: Xeerarka ayaa loo dejiyay xarig madhan = NULL, CHAR buuxinta bannaan, NUMBER aan lahayn saxnaan → NUMERIC, DATE oo leh wakhti → TIMESTAMP, VARCHAR2 BYTE ↔ CHAR dhererka, iyo LONG·RAW.

charset.title: Xarfo-ururin
charset.desc: Xarfo-ururinta isha (KO16MSWIN949, UTF8, …) waa la xaqiijiyay, iyadoo la go'aamiyay tiirarka ka buuxsamay koritaanka multibyte iyo go'doominta xarfaha aan la beddeli karin.

lob.title: LOB
lob.desc: CLOB·BLOB waxaa lagu shubaa qaybo (cabbirka iyo xaddidaadaha xusuusta) waxaana lagu xaqiijiyaa dhererka + hash.

seqResync.title: Dib-u-habaynta isku-xigxiga
seqResync.desc: Ka dib marka la raro, isku-xigxiga bartilmaameedka·aqoonsiyada waxaa loo dejiyay max(furaha)+1.

timezone.title: Aagga wakhtiga · tiirarka nidaamka
timezone.desc: Aagga wakhtiga fasiraadda ee qiimayaasha aan lahayn mid (tusaale Asia/Seoul) waa la dejiyay, kiciyeyaasha wakhtiga la beddelay ma dul-saari doonaan wakhtiyada isha inta lagu jiro raridda, waxaana la dejiyay xeerarka beddelidda abuuraha/wax-ka-beddelaha.

backpressure.title: Cadaadis dhabar · raridda bartilmaameedka
backpressure.desc: Yaree cabbirka qaybta iyo isbarbardhigga dib-u-dhaca bartilmaameedka, koritaanka WAL ama sugitaanka qufulka; dhis tusmooyinka aan-PK ahayn ka dib marka la raro oo ku socodsii ANALYZE·VACUUM ka dib.

migration.verifyHint: Wuxuu soo saaraa tirada, wadarta tiirka nambarada, furaha nuqulka ah iyo furaha hash ee miiska kasta oo ku jira amarka raridda. Adigu ku socodsii isha iyo bartilmaameedka oo isbarbardhig (shaashaddani ma fuliso).
migration.noHashOracle: Oracle·Tibero hawlaha hash iyo soo-bandhigidda qoraalka way ka duwan yihiin PostgreSQL, sidaa darteed su'aalaha hash waa laga tagay — isbarbardhig tirada, wadarta iyo furayaasha nuqulka ah.
migration.copyFail: Lama koobiyeen karin. Dooro qoraalka oo gacanta ku koobiyeey.

engine.title: Fulinta·dib-u-bilowga · tijaabada·dib-u-celinta
engine.body: Fulinta dhabta ah ee guuritaanka (goobaha hubinta, cadaadiska dhabarka, go'doominta safka qaladka) iyo tijaabada, dib-u-celinta iyo diiwaangelinta barta bilowga CDC waxay imaan doonaan ka dib marka la dhammeeyo qaabka amniga wakiilka shaqaalaha (A10). Hadda tan waxaa ku jira qorsheynta, hubinta iyo xaqiijinta SQL.

ops.title: Badbaadada Hawlgallada DB
ops.pickFirst: Marka hore dooro isku xir iyo isku xirka sare
ops.noRun: Wali ma jiraan baaritaan. Riix "Samee baaritaan"
ops.readOnly: Baaritaanku wuxuu akhriyaa kaliya (SELECT). Talooyinku waa hage waxayna ku xiran yihiin xusuusta server-ka, culeyska iyo shaqada
ops.truncated: Waxyaabo badan — kaliya 500-kii ugu horreeyay ayaa la hubiyay
ops.paramsNote: Wadarta xusuusta server-ka lama garanayo, sidaa darteed waxaa lagu qiyaasaa shared_buffers ≈ 25% ee RAM. random_page_cost wuxuu u malaynayaa SSD
ops.auditNote: Miisaska RLS-ka ka maqan iyo akoonnada aan la isticmaalin waa la hubin doonaa marka isku xirka su'aashu uu taageero
ops.replNote: Aasaasku waa Active-Standby (A-S) — hal primary + standby. Dib-u-ciyaarista dib-u-dhaca ≥ 5s = digniin, ≥ 60s = khatar (tixraaca RPO ee la cabbiray)

rules.sb_default: Heerka caadiga ah (128MB). Server gaar ah waxaa lagu talinayaa qiyaastii 25% RAM
rules.sb_ok: Waxaa loo dejiyay ka sarreeya heerka caadiga ah
rules.wm_over: max_connections × work_mem wuxuu ka badan yahay xusuusta la qiyaasay. Kala-soocidda isku mar waxay halis u tahay xusuus la'aan
rules.wm_default: Heerka caadiga ah (4MB). Kala-soocidda waaweyn iyo hashes-ku waxay ku daadan karaan diskiga
rules.mwm_default: Heerka caadiga ah (64MB). VACUUM iyo dhismaha tusmooyinka ayaa laga yaabaa inay gaabis noqdaan; tixgeli 256MB ama ka badan
rules.mwm_ok: Waxaa loo dejiyay ka sarreeya heerka caadiga ah
rules.av_off: autovacuum waa dansan yahay. Khatar sare oo ah bararka miiska iyo wareegga aqoonsiga macaamilka
rules.conn_high: max_connections waa sare. Isku xir kasta wuxuu isticmaalaa xusuus; pooler (PgBouncer iwm.) ayaa lagu talinayaa
rules.lmd_off: Log-ga su'aalaha gaabiska ah waa dansan yahay (-1). Qiyaastii 1000ms ayaa lagu talinayaa
rules.lmd_all: Qoraal kasta waa la diiwaangeliyaa (0). Culeys badan oo log-ga ah
rules.lmd_ok: Log-ga su'aalaha gaabiska ah waa daaran yahay
rules.st_off: Ma jiro wakhti-xaddidid qoraal oo server-ka oo dhan ah (0). Deji xaddidaadyo door kasta ama codsi kasta
rules.iit_off: Ma jiro wakhti-xaddidid aan shaqaynayn-gudaha-macaamilka (0). Waxay sababi kartaa quful hayn iyo barar
rules.iit_ok: Wakhti-xaddidid aan shaqaynayn-gudaha-macaamilka waa la dejiyay
rules.ckpt_short: Wakhtiga hubinta waa 5 daqiiqo ama ka yar. Tixgeli 10–15 daqiiqo culeysyada qorista ee badan
rules.wal_minimal: wal_level=minimal wuxuu ka dhigayaa PITR iyo koobiyeynta mid aan suurtagal ahayn. Isticmaal replica ama ka sareeya
rules.wal_ok: Heerka WAL wuxuu taageeraa PITR iyo koobiyeynta
rules.rpc_hdd: HDD default (4). SSD, 1.1–2 ayaa lagu talinayaa
rules.super_many: Laba ama ka badan superusers. Mid u hayso maamulka oo kuwa kale si kaliya mudnaanta loo baahan yahay

rules.no_expiry: Doorka gelitaanka ee aan lahayn dhicitaanka erayga sirta ah. Deji VALID UNTIL akoonnada shakhsi ahaaneed
rules.expiry_ok: Dhammaan doorarka gelitaanka waxay leeyihiin dhicitaan
rules.public_grant: PUBLIC (door kasta) wuxuu leeyahay mudnaanta miiska. Mudnaanta qorista waa khatar
rules.public_ok: Ma jiraan mudnaanta miiska oo loo siiyay PUBLIC
rules.arc_off: Kaydinta WAL waa dansan tahay, sidaa darteed soo kabashada wakhtiga (PITR) waa mid aan suurtagal ahayn
rules.arc_cmd_empty: archive_mode waa daaran yahay laakiin archive_command iyo archive_library waa madhan yihiin
rules.arc_never: Wali ma jiro WAL la kaydiyay
rules.arc_stale: WAL-kii ugu dambeeyay ee la kaydiyay wuxuu ka weyn yahay 24 saacadood
rules.arc_recent: WAL waxaa la kaydiyay 24 saacadood gudahood
rules.arc_failing: Kaydinta WAL hadda waa fashilantay. Hubi diskiga, ogolaanshaha iyo jidka bartilmaameedka
rules.repl_is_standby: Isku xirkan waa standby (qaabka soo kabashada). Hubi dib-u-dhaca isku xirka primary
rules.repl_none: Ma jiro standby ku xiran. Ma jiro habayn soo kabashada musiibada (DR)
rules.repl_ok: Standbys-ku si caadi ah ayay u shubayaan
rules.repl_lag: Standby wuu dib-u-dhacayaa ama ma shubayo

pgss.title: Sida loo daaro pg_stat_statements
pgss.body: Su'aalaha gaabiska ah ee Top-N waxay u baahan yihiin kordhinta pg_stat_statements. Ku socodsii bayaanka hoose adigoo ah maamulaha DB. Supabase, ka shid Dashboard Database → Extensions.
pgss.note: PostgreSQL-ka isku-martigeliyay wuxuu sidoo kale u baahan yahay pg_stat_statements gudaha shared_preload_libraries (postgresql.conf) iyo dib-u-bilow. Miiska, tusmooyinka iyo tirakoobyada cabbirka waxay shaqeeyaan iyada oo aan lahayn

collect.intro: Hadda ururi wuxuu akhriyaa tirakoobyada su'aalaha sare, miisaska, tusmooyinka iyo cabbirrada hal mar wuxuuna u keydiyaa sida sawir-qaadis. Ururi ugu yaraan laba jeer si aad u aragto isbeddellada iyo isbeddellada cabbirka

pipeline.title: PiCDC · Dhuumaha
pipeline.intro: Hubi in DB-ga isha uu diyaar u yahay qabashada xogta isbeddelka (CDC) oo naqshadee isha → beddel → dhuumaha bartilmaameedka. Marxaladdan waxay kaliya hubisaa oo naqshadeysaa; ma jiraan xog saf ah oo macmiil ah oo la akhriyo ama la kaydiyo.
pipeline.needLink: Marka hore dooro xiriirka schema.pi ee kor ku xusan. Haddii aadan midna lahayn, iska diiwaan geli calaamad ku taal menu-ka 'Xiriir'.
pipeline.needConn: Dooro xiriirka DB ee la hubinayo ee kor ku xusan.
pipeline.runBody: Fulinta dhuumaha, la socodka dib u dhaca iyo dib u habaynta waxay yimaadaan marka wakiilka shaqaalaha iyo qaabka amniga la dhammaystiro. Hadda, ku kaydi qeexitaannada sidii qabyo qoraal (DRAFT).

pre.title: Hubinta hore ee isha
pre.intro: Shaxad kasta, waxay hubisaa tiirarka wakhtiga isbeddelka, tiirarka tirtirka jilicsan iyo furaha aasaasiga ah si ay u soo jeediso habka qabashada (adapter), waxayna hubisaa diyaar garowga WAL logical replication. Kaliya akhriska buug-gacmeedka iyo weydiimaha goobaha.
pre.sum: {tables} shaxadood · {noPk} PK la'aan · {deleteUnseen} ma qaban karaan tirtirka
pre.truncated: Weydiin buug-gacmeedka ayaa gaartay xadka 500-saf, sidaa darteed shaxadaha qaarkood ayaa laga yaabaa inay maqan yihiin. Qeex schema oo mar kale hubi.
pre.toDraft: Samee qabyo qoraal dhuumo ah oo laga soo xushay {n}

ready.ok: WAL logical replication waa diyaar — shaxadaha leh PK waxay isticmaali karaan LOGICAL

reason.NO_PK: Ma jiro furaha aasaasiga ah — safafka isbeddelay lama aqoonsan karo
reason.DELETE_UNSEEN: Polling ma qaban karo DELETE-yada jireed (waxaa lagu taliyay tiirka tirtirka jilicsan)
reason.LOGICAL_NOT_READY: Wuxuu u beddeli karaa LOGICAL marka WAL logical replication uu diyaar noqdo
reason.FULL_RELOAD_ONLY: Ma jiro PK ama tiirka wakhtiga isbeddelka, sidaa darteed ma jiro qabasho kordhin ah — ku dar PK
reason.WAL_NOT_LOGICAL: wal_level ma aha logical (beddelidda waxay u baahan tahay dib u bilawga DB)
reason.IS_STANDBY: Server-ka standby — ka qaado logical replication server-ka aasaasiga ah
reason.SETTINGS_UNKNOWN: Ma akhrin karin goobaha, diyaar garowga lama garanayo

sqlLab.title: SQL Tuning Lab
sqlLab.intro: Dooro xiriir oo geli SQL si aad u aragto qorshaha fulinta sidii geed, oo leh sababaha gaabiska (baadhitaanada buuxa, wareegyada isku xidhan, kala soocidda waaweyn) iyo SQL anti-patterns oo lagu hubiyay schema.pi domain-yada caadiga ah. Weydiimaha dhab ahaantii lama fuliyo (ma jiro ANALYZE).
sqlLab.needLink: Dooro xiriir iyo xiriir kor ku xusan si aad u aragto qorshayaasha. Hubinta anti-pattern waxay shaqeysaa iyada oo aan xiriir lahayn.
sqlLab.sqlPlaceholder: SELECT ord_id, ord_amt FROM ord WHERE cust_id = ...
sqlLab.saveName: Summad (tusaale: ka hor inta aan la gelin tusmo)
sqlLab.saveNote: Qiimaha joogtada ah ee SQL iyo shuruudaha qorshaha waxaa lagu qariyaa ? marka la kaydiyo.

warn.SEQ_SCAN_LARGE: Baadhitaan buuxa oo ku saabsan {relation} (qiyaastii {rows} saf) — tixgeli tusmo ku saabsan tiirarka shaandhada.
warn.NESTED_LOOP_HIGH: Wareegga isku xidhan wuxuu soo saaraa qiyaastii {rows} saf — tixgeli hash ama merge join, ama tusmo ku saabsan shuruudaha join.
warn.SORT_SPILL: Cabbirka kala soocidda waa qiyaastii {kb}KB, oo ka sarreeya work_mem-ka asalka ah (4MB); waxaa laga yaabaa inay ku daadato diskiga.

lint.title: Hubinta SQL anti-pattern
lint.domainsOff: Domain-yada caadiga ah lama soo shubi karin; waxaa lagu hubiyay kaliya xeerarka suffix-ka tiirka asalka ah.

codes.SELECT_STAR: SELECT * — dooro kaliya tiirarka aad u baahan tahay (I/O dheeraad ah, ma jiro tusmo daboolaya).
codes.FUNC_ON_COLUMN: Tiirka shaandhada {column} waxaa lagu duubay hawlgal ama muujin, sidaa darteed tusmaheeda lama isticmaali karo — beddel joogtada ah.
codes.LEADING_WILDCARD: LIKE oo leh % hormood ah ma isticmaali karo tusmo B-tree ah — tixgeli tusmo pg_trgm GIN ah.
codes.OR_DIFF_COLUMNS: Shuruudaha tiirarka kala duwan waxaa lagu daray OR — tixgeli UNION ALL ama tusmooyinka tiir kasta.
codes.IMPLICIT_CAST: {column} waxaa lagu barbardhigayaa tiro la soo xigtay — isku dheji tiirka iyo noocyada joogtada ah (implicit cast).
codes.NOT_IN_SUBQUERY: NOT IN (subquery) waxba ma soo celiso marka NULLs ay jiraan waana gaabis — isticmaal NOT EXISTS.
codes.NO_WHERE: Ma jiro WHERE clause — shaxad weyn tani waa baadhitaan buuxa (ku dar shuruud ama LIMIT).
codes.DOMAIN_MISMATCH: {column} waa nooc {expected} ah oo ku salaysan domain-ka caadiga ah laakiin waxaa lagu barbardhigayaa joogto nooc kale ah — implicit cast-ka ayaa laga yaabaa inuu ka hortago isticmaalka tusmada.

ai.title: Talooyinka AI tuning
ai.body: Waa soo socotaa (ka dib marka la ansixiyo iyo habraacyada cabbirka saamaynta) — talooyinka waxaa laga soo saari doonaa SQL oo leh joogtooyin la qariyay waxaana loo diiwaan gelin doonaa sidii la codsaday kaliya ka dib marka la ansixiyo DA iyo saamaynta la cabbiray.
